I fixed the site. Both visual snapshots (desktop and phone) now match the approved baselines, with 2 of 2 passing and no baseline changes. All three bugs were in `site/css/styles.css`.

1. **Nav links stacked vertically on desktop.** In the `.navbar-expand-lg .navbar-nav` rule (≥992px), `flex-direction` was `column`. I changed it back to `row`.
2. **Paragraph spacing too large.** `p { margin-bottom }` was `1.5rem`. I changed it back to `1rem`.
3. **Hero subtitle ("Landing Page Template") was dark on the grey background.** `.text-white-50` was `rgba(0,0,0,.5)`. I changed it back to `rgba(255,255,255,.5)`.

I didn't approve or change any baselines.
